results.content: # Trump approval rating hits new career low in latest AP-NORC poll. President Donald Trump’s approval rating hit a new career low in Associated Press-NORC polling, with less than one-third of surveyed Americans approving of his job performance in the White House. The poll, released Thursday, Oct. 1, found Trump’s approval rating at 31%, the lowest the president has seen in either of his two terms. Trump’s performance in Thursday’s poll also marks a two-percentage-point drop compared to the last AP-NORC poll in July.
